questions.q: What is the passage mainly about?
options: How rural communities can start and fund a local food bank program
Food-as-medicine programs: their nature, history and need for stronger evidence
The Trump administration's Eat Real Food campaign and its critics
How changing weather and fuel delays drive up crop prices worldwide
questions.explain: It explains the movement, its history and local results, then says larger high-quality studies are needed.

questions.q: Where did Dr. Jack Geiger co-found community health centers in the 1960s?
options: Appalachia and the South Side of Chicago
New Orleans and the Georgia Sea Islands
South Boston and the Mississippi Delta
Harlem and the Alabama Black Belt
questions.explain: He co-founded health centers in South Boston and the Mississippi Delta.

questions.q: What did the authors' food box program for 55 households show after two years?
options: Lower blood sugar, cholesterol and blood pressure readings
Reductions in weight, waist circumference and triglycerides
No statistically significant change in any health measure
Fewer hospital admissions and lower emergency room costs
questions.explain: They found significant reductions in weight, waist circumference and triglyceride levels.

questions.q: What limit did the authors cite for their food box project's 'dose'?
options: Only four to five meals a week were supplemented
Households received food only once a month
Only children received food
Boxes had no fresh vegetables
questions.explain: Their project supplemented only four to five meals per week, which may have been insufficient.

questions.q: What would the authors say is needed before food is medicine can change standard care?
options: More grocery stores and supermarkets in rural food deserts
Larger, high-quality studies tracking clinical outcomes
Mandatory insurance coverage for every food prescription
Fewer local programs so funding can be concentrated
questions.explain: They say that larger, high-quality studies are needed to track clinical outcomes before any shift in practice.
